definitions.independent_unit: raw_process_seed; average the two directions within seed; estimator variants, origins, trials, oracle rollouts, and reruns do not multiply the seed replication count
definitions.predictive_log_loss_gain: heldout binary_log_loss(activity/history baseline) minus binary_log_loss(graph augmented predictor); positive is better prediction
definitions.omission_score: heldout binary_log_loss(omitted candidate outgoing graph feature block) minus binary_log_loss(full augmented predictor); predictive contribution, not an intervention effect
definitions.topk_recovery: Gold neurons have paired future outgoing-disconnection probability reduction >=0.10. k is the intervention-defined gold-set size, with neuron scores descending and lexical unit tie-break. Mean of two directional recalls per seed; gold-size ranking is not an operational nomination rule.
definitions.group_recovery: group:driver_pair={0,1}; group:control_pair={2,7}. Require joint pair simulator effect >=0.10 per direction, mean group score minus control score >0, group-win fraction >=0.75, plus positive predictive gain.
definitions.fixed_cutoff_nomination: Any candidate neuron or predeclared group with omission score strictly >0.01 nats is nominated. It is false if paired simulator effect <0.10. Any false candidate in either direction is one seed event.
definitions.null_exact_bound: one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper95 = beta quantile(.95,k+1,n-k); evaluated per method/seed event, without simultaneous coverage or neuron-level FDR.
definitions.intervals: reported 95% descriptive percentile bootstrap means over independent seeds, 2000 resamples, complete eligible planned set; SD is sample SD across seed means. No paired superiority p-values.
definitions.direction_alignment: minimum of source-well purity and class-conditional target agreement; train-only semantic map and held-out audit; natural-observation alignment does not establish invariance under intervention.

oracle_interpretation.single_driver: Exactly one neuron per direction passes the effect cutoff in every seed; group driver pair includes it.
oracle_interpretation.redundant_group: All 40 directional joint pair effects >=0.3448275862; individual effects are small (neuron0 <=0.017578125, neuron1 <=0.01416015625) and below0.10, hence individual top-k unavailable by design; joint recovery is the relevant gate.
oracle_interpretation.correlated_bystander: Same source-specific intervention-positive drivers as single_driver; neuron2 is a correlated proxy with zero outgoing-disconnection effect. Low recovery cannot be rescued by predictive bystander scores.
oracle_interpretation.null: All measured candidate/group intervention effects exactly zero; false nomination bounds fail despite clean oracle truth.
oracle_interpretation.hidden_confounder: All observed candidate/group intervention effects exactly zero; source intentionally lacks observed neuronal causation. Diagnostic status and occasional/no false nomination do not certify confounding identification.

figure_mapping.meaning: Mean actual paired outgoing-disconnection risk reduction by scenario, candidate, and semantic direction. Oracle deduplicated across methods.
figure_mapping.uncertainty: Source figure shows descriptive means only; derived SD across seeds included in JSON.

figure_mapping.meaning: Per-method mean signed predictive candidate omission score for semantic0-to1; both directions remain in evidence and acceptance.
figure_mapping.uncertainty: Source figure means have no uncertainty bars.

figure_mapping.meaning: Individual recall in single_driver and correlated_bystander, redundancy group-win fraction, exact upper95 null false nomination bound, frozen threshold lines.

prior_comparison.interpretation: Reproduction on the same raw-process seeds, with exactly shared intervention truth and reference hashes. Fast omission scores reproduce exactly and gains match within solver last bits. Conventional omission scores and gains differ materially. Source fingerprint changed; outputs alone do not identify the reason or isolate a hardware effect. No new independent seed evidence is added.

scientific_limits: This study is transition-driver recovery and remains separate from native graph-comparison/edge-recovery results.
Four related CSL variants belong to one family and do not supply independent methodological confirmation.
Frozen development protocol was not externally preregistered; acceptance means only its declared synthetic benchmark.
Full execution and adequate alignment/event support do not override failed recovery, negative gain, and null calibration.
All positive-control means are below the zero predictive-gain gate; uncertainty summaries are descriptive, not a claim of inferential superiority.
Simulator oracle uses finite256 paired Monte Carlo rollouts; this does not establish real-neuron biological necessity.
No biological causal identification, confounding robustness, broad observation/misspecification robustness, or independent-animal replication is established.
Per-scenario uses the same declared positive seed IDs; do not pool directions or methods as independent seeds or add reruns to the replication count.
